agent-kill-switch v1.1.0 introduces a structured "kill switch" protocol for AI agent deployments.

- Generates a "brake card" specifying stop conditions, privilege removal actions, responsible personnel, and recovery criteria before agent deployment.
- Includes a --check command to ensure the brake card is complete; missing fields set exit code rc=1 and block rollout.
- Clear boundaries set: does not replace professional/legal judgment; sensitive info must use a vault.
- Details usage guidance, failure modes, and compliance/disclaimer notes.
- Cross-platform (Windows, Mac, Linux); zero-dependency (stdlib only).
- Adds Chinese and English display names and documentation.
